BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Vlam the Flame Dragon!!
S-so this is what causes the river to lose water?!
T-that's a pretty rough way to do it...\nBut releasing flames from its mouth into the water\nis kinda nasty...Seeing it disgusts me!
Hey, stop it!\nWhat a nasty way to dry the spring up!!
Huh? Who the hey are you?\nThis forest will be over without this spring.\nDon't you dare get in my way!!
Do you really think that we'll just sit here and\ndo nothing?!
Ou...ugh...\nYou may think that you've won, but...\nThis spring is over!!
Ohh?!
Whoa! If it's flying that high, our attacks won't\nhit it!!
Just sit back and watch the spring evaporate!\nBwahahaha!!
Aaaaaaahhh!!
W-w-what was that?!
[ffff64]You've got a Flame-Shaped Crest.[ffffff] There's a hollow\nin the middle for something...Doesn't look like\nsomething that belongs to a dragon though...
Hm??? What's this?\nLemme see it!
I see, I see, this thing is...made of some kind of\nmysterious metal that I've never seen before...
A dragon's crest made of mysterious metal...\nMy gut as a merchant is telling me that it must be\nvaluable!
I'll keep this for you...I know, just relax.\nI'm not gonna walk off with it!!
Oh, it's you! The "Blessing Bearer"!!
Whaaat?!
Looks like you all come from the world I was in...\nNice to meet you.
They call me the "Blessing Bearer" here, but in\nyour world, my name is Vasaria...
Whaat?? Vasa what...???
Oh yeah, I remember now!!\nVasaria is the name of the goddess of water!!
Right...\nThat's one of the 12 names seen in the\nShrine of the Gods...
Whoaaa...I can't believe that I'm meeting a\ngoddess again...But wait, what is a goddess from\nour world doing in this world?
It's embarrassing, but right after joining the\nworld hastily during the cataclysm, an unknown\nforce caused me to crash into this world, Toram...
S-so the story about gods joining the ground in a\nhaste during the cataclysm was real...
But then even if you're a goddess, it must have\nbeen tough here, right? I bet you've been attacked\nby Coenubias and monsters before.
Yes, I've been attacked by Coenubias numerous\ntimes while wandering around Toram.
But the fact that Coenubias are weak to water and\nI myself am the goddess of water has helped me\nget through this...
Even for a goddess, it must have been hard to have\nno one but yourself to depend on in an unknown\nworld...
Yes...But, while wandering around this world,\nI've felt the presence of other gods several\ntimes...
I don't know whether they came here on purpose or\nthey're stranded here too, but I'm sure there are\nother gods besides me...
...Well, we originally came to this world to go\nafter Coenubias, but...
I think this is not gonna be just a tale about an\nadventure in another world, but also a story about\nfinding the gods of our world...
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing. Let's go back!
Explore here a little longer!
